description: H100-BROAD hourly panel (METHODOLOGY.md). Underlying: a BLENDED rate across H100-class capacity as each provider chooses to sell it (SXM, PCIe and NVL mixed) -- composition is the instrument, so NO identity screen and NO variant rules exist here; the sku set is the screen. 22 members, weight floor 1.25% (at 2.5% the floors would consume 55% and collapse differentiation), claim floor 8. Selection over the raw-observatory record; captures nothing.

calc.description: calc_v1 (panel genesis mint; METHODOLOGY.md is the binding methodology document -- this text is the summary). The index and its weights recompute at EVERY hourly observation (rule A1); the fallback->dynamic switch adopts the 50% attendance floor (rule A2). RECORD: raw-observatory hourly snapshots from the 2026-08-23 genesis -- no basket era, no stitching. SKU SET: {H100, H100_PCIE, H100_NVL} -- H100T is EXCLUDED pending the open H100T-as-H100-class call, which leaves Oracle's seat INERT (its only H100-class listing is H100T, filed under its own catalog sku). The lowest-eligible rule runs across the whole sku set, so each seat prints its cheapest form factor -- the composition effect is the instrument (expect roughly 10-15% below H100-SXM), and a provider changing which variant it lists moves the index with no underlying price change (accepted, bounded by the jump screen, the 30% ceiling, and predictiveness drift). MARKETPLACE STATISTICS (METHODOLOGY.md section 7): vast via vast_vwm_verified_us_ca_floor over the UNION of its eligible rows across the sku set (accounting gate + >= 5 machines / >= 3 hosts floors); lium via lium_vwm_book_floor (>= 5 machines / >= 3 miners). NO parity leg: no predecessor series exists for this instrument. TIER SCREEN: eligibility is the ALLOW-LIST calc.eligible_tiers, on-demand only -- methodology section 5 as written, replacing the exclusion-list interruptible_tiers screen (which had grown 'serverless' for verda's serverless-SPOT rows, recorded well under its on-demand rate at probe 2026-08-24T00Z; the allow-list screens those and every other non-on-demand tier mechanically -- a serverless GPU-second is also a different underlying, the recorded fal-exclusion rationale). This mint RECONCILES the methodology section 15 committed-tier limitation: hyperstack's reserved 'Starting from' floors, together's reserved tenors, and latitude's monthly-commit rows never print here, and gmicloud's from_floor and fal's serverless rows remain out by tier (the frozen daily B300/B200 series kept committed/reserved eligible; this panel has no daily predecessor). MEMBER EXTRA SCREEN: runpod's record carries Secure AND Community rows under one structured label, distinguished only by the collector's extra.cloud field -- the seat's extra_require admits cloud 'secure' only (the membership rule excludes Community; basket-era rows carry no extra dict and pass, that era being secure-only by construction). OPEN METHODOLOGY CALLS (recorded): Oracle H100T-as-H100-class (seat inert until decided); lium population definition and both marketplace floor values; sesterce 'From'-floor prints; shadeform conditional admission not built; window/warm-up/confirm counts span hours. Any param change touching a published calc_v1 observation mints calc_v2. AMENDED INTO THIS MINT BEFORE ANY OBSERVATION PUBLISHED (perf review 2026-08-23): (a) drift_scan_observations moved out of calc to a TOP-LEVEL operational key -- the drift-scan bound gates an ops sweep, never the series bytes (the fallback_parity_methodology_id precedent), so it no longer rides calc_params under the D2 fence, and the scan runs on the 16:00Z firing (or --drift-scan) instead of every firing; (b) replay is BOUNDED: state rebuilds from the trailing state window (dw history + max forward horizon + prune margin -- the weight-state prune bound, inside which every consulted state fully rebuilds) behind the publish frontier, seeded by the latest pre-window artifact for the weight-mode latch and the D2 baseline, and the manual-exclusion pin check covers published artifacts inside that window only (older artifacts are immutable; their pins were enforced when the frontier passed them); (c) the ECB feed is fetched only when an unpublished observation day cannot resolve a stored rate after walk-back (stored FX reads bounded to the window plus the staleness allowance). AMENDED INTO THIS MINT BEFORE ANY OBSERVATION PUBLISHED (harden review 2026-08-23): (d) the fallback->dynamic switch quorum additionally requires a NON-EMPTY attendance-passer set -- with zero passers (every candidate below the attendance floor, a lane-wide outage's aftermath) the every-passer-has-Q clause is vacuously true and one post-outage observation could have flipped the PERMANENT latch on zero attendance information, inverting the A2 intent; genesis is unaffected (a zero-scheduled window makes every candidate a passer at ratio 1.0); (e) row eligibility fails closed on NON-FINITE prices: a candidate row must carry a finite native price (and a finite USD price when one is present) or it is excluded and counted (screen_counts non_finite_price) -- json admits NaN/Infinity literals and non-USD rows skip the capture-side USD plausibility band, so a non-finite native could otherwise poison the lowest-eligible min; capture-side normalization now also flags non-finite natives implausible (flag-only, future snapshots only); (f) a new top-level record_exclusions key ([{date, hour, reason}]) quarantines a poisoned/unparseable record object at an unpublished stamp: the observation publishes an explicit record_quarantined artifact (index null, observation_missed false) WITHOUT reading the record -- instead of the lane wedging forever behind publish-in-order -- and the key rides calc_params, pinned per published observation exactly like manual_exclusions. Artifact-visibility hardening in the same review: silent ok-status seats pin eligible_rows plus per-screen screen_counts (a seat whose rows ALL screen out is distinguishable from one with no rows at all -- the dead-seat tripwire), and an observation_missed artifact publishes only after a confirming FRESH re-LIST of the slot keys (a transient empty LIST must never pin an immutable false missed record).
